=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1445-1464 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `run_report`, the skip branch sets `save_marker = bool(gate.get("save_marker"))` and never checks `write_failed`, so the cache marker is saved even when the status-issue PATCH/POST failed.
  WHY: The (SHA, UTC day) cache key suppresses every later tick, so the skip report and the stale-maintenance-PR flag stay unpublished until main changes or the UTC day rolls over, which contradicts the line-1463 comment; severity disagreement: MAJOR (sonnet, gemini, minimax) vs NIT (luna, glm), highest used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1132-1147 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `run_decisions` resets `asked_at` for an existing decision issue to the decisions-step time (`now = _iso(_now())`) but keeps the `comments` count that collect read up to ~75 minutes earlier.
  WHY: The next run's `trusted_answers` (lines 457-465) drops, via `created < cutoff`, any trusted answer posted between collect and decisions, so the answer is never applied and the decision issue stays open (Goal 7 / Q8 A).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:874-894 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `check_diff` archive branch (`elif status in ("M", "A") and path in archived.values() and path in completed_exists`) accepts status `M`, so an archive can overwrite an existing `docs/completed/<name>.md` as long as the new blob equals the deleted plan's blob.
  WHY: `completed_exists` is built from the already-edited workspace (`run_apply` line 1028), and nothing checks that the target was absent before the audit, so an earlier completed plan is silently replaced in the sweep commit; severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, confidence 3) vs MAJOR (others), highest used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:423-428, 1445-1455 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_attach_status_issue` swallows `ReadError` and leaves `status_issue == ""`, so on `no_plans`/`no_orchestrator` skips the `run_report` `visible_skip` path POSTs a new "Plan autopilot status" issue.
  WHY: A transient 5xx or rate-limit error on the `ai:plan-autopilot` listing creates a duplicate status issue and splits the state marker (`dispatched_at`, `decision_issues`) across issues, which breaks Goal 8 (one status issue per repo).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:655-656, 909-920 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Removal preflight evidence is only shape-checked (`{check, result}` strings) in `_semantic_errors`/`check_diff`; nothing verifies that the trigger was met or that the checks passed.
  WHY: The audit model can return schema-valid but fabricated preflight results, including for checks that must fail as unrunnable, and the host-side apply step will commit and push deletions of non-permanent, non-protected registry paths.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:127 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `AUTO_CLOSE_RE` strips only the `#N` and `owner/repo#N` forms, not the URL form `closes https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/N`.
  WHY: Model-derived `stale`/`changed` fields and de-scoped checkbox text can carry `Fixes https://github.com/<repo>/issues/<N>` into the maintenance PR body, and the lint step blocks only tracking-issue targets, so auto-merge closes issue N.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The loop resumes on its own when main changes or a decision is answered." (Goal 10)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml plan-autopilot cache key/due gate; scripts/plan_autopilot.py `run_collect` decision-answer collection path
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The cache key (`plan-autopilot-v1-${PLAN_AUTOPILOT_SHA}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)`, orchestrate_poll.yml lines 583 and 590-594) depends only on the default-branch SHA and the UTC date, and a cache hit skips the job; `run_collect()` reads decision answers only after the job starts (lines 475-487); decision comments neither change the key nor trigger the workflow; the 30-minute dispatch-grace covers the dispatch half, not decision answers
- requirement: "An answer is applied by a later audit only when it comes from an `OWNER` / `MEMBER` / `COLLABORATOR` comment. The issue is then closed (`state_reason: completed`) with a link to the PR that applied it." (Goal 7)
  expected_change_site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py `run_decisions` `asked_at` assignment (around line ~1147)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `asked_at` is recorded as the time `run_decisions` runs, not the collect timestamp, so `trusted_answers` drops answers posted in the collect-to-decisions interval; `test_decision_without_collected_answer_stays_open` covers only the no-answer case; no diff hunk sets `asked_at` from the collect timestamp
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 127 `AUTO_CLOSE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:close[sd]?|fix(?:e[sd])?|resolve[sd]?)\b\s*:?\s*(?:[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+)?#\d+", re.I)` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Auto-close stripping misses the URL form `closes https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/N`, which `scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` (line 72, lines 79-84) treats as an auto-close reference.
  WHY: Model- or plan-derived text with `Fixes https://github.com/<repo>/issues/<N>` reaches the maintenance PR body, the lint blocks only tracking-issue targets, and auto-merge closes issue N; the test covers only `#` forms; suggested fix: add `https?://github\.com/[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+/issues/\d+` (also covers `compose_description`).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:`run_report`, line 1464 (with lines 1445, 1452-1457) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `write_failed` marker hold applies only in the proceed branch; the skip branch takes `gate.save_marker` (True for `no_plans`, `no_orchestrator`, `maintenance_pr_open`) even after a failed create/PATCH.
  WHY: The marker is saved and later ticks that day cache-hit, so the stale-maintenance-PR flag does not appear until a new main commit or the next UTC day; suggested fix: `bool(gate.get("save_marker")) and not write_failed`.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:`run_decisions`, line 1132 `now = _iso(_now())` and line 1147; `trusted_answers`, line 458 onward | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `asked_at` is reset to the decisions-step time, up to ~75 minutes after collect read the comments, while the saved `comments` count is the one collect saw.
  WHY: An answer posted between collect and decisions predates the new `asked_at` and is dropped, so Goal 7 / Q8 A fails; suggested fix: use the collect timestamp from state["collect"].
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:`check_diff`, line 878 `elif status in ("M", "A") and path in archived.values() and path in completed_exists:` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Status `M` is accepted, so an existing `docs/completed/<name>.md` can be overwritten; the blob check never confirms the target was absent.
  WHY: An earlier archived plan is silently replaced in the maintenance PR; suggested fix: accept only `A`.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:`_attach_status_issue`, lines 423-428; `run_report`, lines 1445 and 1452 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A swallowed lookup `ReadError` looks the same as "no status issue", so `no_plans`/`no_orchestrator` skips POST a new status issue.
  WHY: This creates a duplicate `ai:plan-autopilot` issue (Goal 8), can repeat in each (SHA, day) slot, and splits the state marker; suggested fix: add a `status_lookup_failed` flag and exclude those runs from `visible_skip`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:655-656, 917-920 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Only the shape of removal-preflight evidence is checked, not that the checks passed or the triggers were met.
  WHY: Fabricated, schema-valid preflight results (including unrunnable checks) lead to committed and pushed deletions of unprotected registry paths.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:874-880, 891-893 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The archive check accepts a modified destination with a matching blob and never checks whether the destination already existed.
  WHY: The model can overwrite an existing completed plan.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1447-1458, 1463-1464 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: On a deterministic skip, a failed status-issue create/update does not stop the cache marker from being saved.
  WHY: Retries are suppressed for the (SHA, UTC day) slot, and the status report stays missing or stale.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1132-1147 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `asked_at` is reset to `now` while `comments` keeps the collect-time count.
  WHY: An answer posted between collect and decisions is dropped by `trusted_answers`.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:423-428, 1445-1452 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_attach_status_issue` swallows ReadError, and the visible_skip path then POSTs a new status issue.
  WHY: A transient lookup error creates a duplicate `ai:plan-autopilot` issue.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "The loop resumes on its own when main changes or a decision is answered."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml plan-autopilot cache key/gate and the decision-answer collection path in scripts/plan_autopilot.py
  Evidence of absence: The cache key uses only the default-branch SHA and the UTC date, a cache hit skips the job, and decision comments neither change the key nor trigger the workflow.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:run_report(), save_marker computation, lines ~1447-1464 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: On a gate skip, save_marker copies `gate["save_marker"]` without checking `write_failed`.
  WHY: The cache hits for the rest of the (SHA, UTC day) slot, so the status issue stays stale, and the "retried by a later tick" comment is false for this branch.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:run_decisions(), line ~1132 and line ~1147 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `asked_at` is overwritten with the decisions-step time, and `trusted_answers` (`created < cutoff` at line ~465) drops answers posted after the collect snapshot.
  WHY: The late answer is never applied (Goal 7); `asked_at` should be the collect timestamp.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:check_diff(), lines ~874-880 and ~891-893 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The archive accepts "M"/"A" for `docs/completed/<name>.md` whether or not the file existed before, and `completed_exists` comes from the live glob.
  WHY: An existing completed plan can be overwritten, and no test covers this case.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:run_apply()/check_diff() and validate_result(), lines ~655-656 and ~917-920 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The apply step trusts the model's preflight results; only the shape and the permanent/protected refusals are enforced.
  WHY: Fabricated preflight evidence lets the model delete unprotected script paths.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:_attach_status_issue() lines ~423-428; run_report() visible_skip lines ~1445-1452 | severity=MAJOR |
